traits.name: American History (1)
traits.summary: The history of the United States and the American Empire that replaced it.
traits.effect: This character has knowledge of American history and can be assumed to be familiar with the history of the United States and the American Empire that replaced it.

traits.name: American Geography (1)
traits.summary: The Empire’s Earth territories, from the Californias to Nueva Mexico.
traits.effect: This character has knowledge of American geography and can be assumed to be familiar with the American Empire’s territories on Earth and in its colonies.

traits.name: Imperial Law (1)
traits.summary: The American Empire’s legal code, its courts and how they’re enforced.
traits.effect: This character has knowledge of the American Empire’s legal code and can be assumed to be familiar with the laws and courts of its territories.

traits.name: English (Spoken)
traits.summary: One of the common languages of Earth Baseline.
traits.effect: This character is conversational in the English language and can speak it.

traits.name: English (Written)
traits.summary: One of the common languages of Earth Baseline.
traits.effect: This character can read and write the English language.

traits.name: Concealment
traits.summary: Hiding things, and yourself.
traits.effect: This character gains +3 to rolls relating to sneaking, hiding, or staying concealed.

traits.name: Sleight of Hand
traits.summary: Quick, unnoticed work with the hands.
traits.effect: This character gains +5 to Grace when attempting to pickpocket, deceive, or impress with their hands.

traits.name: Haggler
traits.summary: Getting a better price.
traits.effect: This character gains +5 to Persuasion or Demeanor checks relating to haggling, bartering, and price negotiations.

traits.name: Criminal Underworld (1)
traits.summary: The gangs, fences and smugglers who work outside the law, and the rules they keep among themselves.
traits.effect: This character has knowledge of organized crime and can be assumed to be familiar with its gangs, fences, black markets and the unwritten rules between them.

traits.name: Streetwise
traits.summary: Getting by, and getting answers, on the street.
traits.effect: This character gains +3 to Memory and Logic rolls relating to urban or city environments.

traits.name: Smooth Talker
traits.summary: Talking people into things, or out of them.
traits.effect: This character gains +2 to Persuasion or Demeanor rolls.

traits.name: Schemer
traits.summary: Plotting and seeing through plots.
traits.effect: This character gains +3 to Logic and Persuasion rolls when attempting to trick or deceive.

traits.name: Pilot: Truck (1)
traits.summary: Flying cargo trucks between stations, ships and planetary surfaces.
traits.effect: This character is capable of piloting Truck Class Voidships in simple scenarios without a Skill Check and is capable of describing the basic functions and controls of a Truck Class Voidship. Rank *10 added to Skill Check rolls involving Truck Class Voidship piloting.

traits.name: Disguise (1)
traits.summary: Passing as someone else, through costume, makeup and manner.
traits.effect: This character is capable of putting together a convincing simple disguise without a skill check. Rank *5 added to skill check rolls involving disguise and impersonation.

traits.name: Mandarin (Spoken)
traits.summary: The language of the Empire of China.
traits.effect: This character is conversational in the Mandarin language and can speak it.

traits.name: Appraisal
traits.summary: Judging what something is worth.
traits.effect: This character gains +8 to rolls for accurately appraising the value of artifacts, merchandise, or commodities in fields that it has familiarity with.

traits.name: Spanish (Spoken)
traits.summary: One of the common languages of Earth Baseline.
traits.effect: This character is conversational in the Spanish language and can speak it.

traits.name: Spanish (Written)
traits.summary: One of the common languages of Earth Baseline.
traits.effect: This character can read and write the Spanish language.

traits.name: Cargo Handling
traits.summary: Loading, securing and moving freight, in gravity or out of it.
traits.effect: This character gains +3 to rolls relating to the handling, tracking, or maintenance of cargo.

traits.name: Thieves' Cant (Spoken)
traits.summary: The coded slang criminals use to talk business in plain hearing.
traits.effect: This character can speak and understand Thieves' Cant, passing hidden messages in ordinary conversation.

traits.name: Wielder: Dagger (1)
traits.summary: Fighting with, and maintaining, daggers and knives.
traits.effect:
- Rank *5 added to skill check rolls involving a Dagger.
- +3 to Attack Rolls made with a Dagger, at any Rank.
- This character is capable of performing the basic tasks of maintaining a Dagger without a skill check.

traits.name: Hidden Holds
traits.summary: Stashing goods where nobody looks.
traits.effect: This character gains +5 to rolls relating to hiding goods in vehicles, cargo, or luggage.

traits.name: Checkpoint Nerve
traits.summary: Staying cool when the guards come knocking.
traits.effect: This character gains +3 to Persuasion or Demeanor rolls when dealing with customs officers, inspectors, and guards.

traits.name: Greasing Palms
traits.summary: Knowing who to pay, and how much.
traits.effect:
- This character gains +5 to Persuasion rolls when offering a bribe.
- This character can request Advantage when judging whether someone can be bought.

traits.name: Fence
traits.summary: Moving goods that can't be sold in the open.
traits.effect: This character gains +3 to Persuasion rolls when negotiating the price of stolen or contraband goods.

traits.name: Running Dark
traits.summary: Flying where nobody's watching.
traits.effect: This character can request Advantage on piloting Skill Checks to avoid detection, such as slipping past patrols or sensor sweeps.

traits.name: Wielder: Pistol (1)
traits.summary: Fighting with, and maintaining, a pistol.
traits.effect:
- Rank *5 added to skill check rolls involving a Pistol.
- +3 to Attack Rolls made with a Pistol, at any Rank.
- This character is capable of performing the basic tasks of maintaining a Pistol without a skill check.

traits.name: Knife Work (1)
traits.summary: Fighting dirty with a short blade.
traits.effect: Rank *2 added to the Piercing damage of this character's Attacks with a knife or other small bladed weapon against a target that hasn't acted yet this Round.

traits.name: Bolt
traits.summary: Getting out while the getting's good.
traits.effect: This character gains the Bolt Action.
traits.action: Bolt: This character takes Full Movement at +5 Priority for the Round. This character gains the Flat-Footed Condition the following Round.

traits.name: Sh!t Talk
traits.summary: Running their mouth to throw people off.
traits.effect: This character gains the Sh!t Talk Action.
traits.action: Sh!t Talk: As an RP Action and Defend, this character keeps up a stream of fast talk. One character within 5 m who can hear and understand them takes -2 to Attack Rolls against this character this Round.

traits.name: Dock Rat
traits.summary: At home on any dock, berth, or station.
traits.effect: This character gains +3 to rolls in ports, stations, and docks to find a berth, a crew, or work off the books.

traits.name: Route Memory
traits.summary: Never forgetting a way once traveled.
traits.effect: This character can request Advantage on Memory Skill Checks to retrace any route they've traveled before, whether on foot, by vehicle, or by ship, and to recall its landmarks, hazards, and checkpoints.

traits.name: Sizing Up
traits.summary: Reading one person across the table.
traits.effect: After a few minutes of conversation with someone, this character can request Advantage on Empathy Skill Checks to judge whether they're lying or can be trusted.

traits.name: Eagle Eye
traits.summary: Sees unusually well at a distance.
traits.effect: This character can request advantage in situations that involve seeing at distance.

traits.name: Cover Identity
traits.summary: Living as someone else, down to the details.
traits.effect: This character gains +5 to Demeanor and Memory rolls relating to keeping up a false identity under scrutiny.

traits.name: Poker Face
traits.summary: Giving nothing away.
traits.effect: This character gains +3 to Demeanor rolls relating to hiding their intentions or reactions.

traits.name: Procurement
traits.summary: Finding hard-to-get goods through the right sellers.
traits.effect: This character gains +5 to rolls relating to sourcing rare, restricted or hard-to-find goods.

features.name: Generalists
features.description: Humans get a +1 bonus to every focus stat.

features.name: Unexceptional
features.description: Humans can't exceed 15 in any focus stat unless otherwise modified.

background.name: The American Empire: Earth
background.summary: You were born in the Empire’s Earth territories, anywhere from the Californias and the Great Lakes to Nueva Mexico, in a country that calls itself the new Rome and is rarely short of a war to prove it.

background.name: Smuggler
background.summary: Moves goods past the law, by ship, caravan or cart, along whatever routes the authorities aren’t watching.

background.name: Gutter Trash
background.summary: Grew up on the streets with nothing, and learned to take what wasn’t given and to disappear when it mattered.
